panels.title: Backend up

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="tron-backend", instance=~"$instance", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="tron-backend", instance=~"$instance", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) or vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="tron-backend", instance=~"$instance", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="tron-backend", instance=~"$instance", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="tron-backend", instance=~"$instance", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
